title: Program Holdings per Building under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
**Desk rule.** A building owner may hold an air quality program under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs at each of their buildings, and there is no cap on the number of programs one owner holds. A second program is not quoted for a site that already holds one in quoted, active, pending renewal or suspended status; the covered units of that program are amended instead. Filter credits are held per program and are never moved between buildings, because the filter sizes and the schedule belong to one building's equipment. Programs in expired, cancelled or declined status do not block a fresh quote.

### What the desk reads before a quote is opened

Whether a site already holds a program is read from the program records of the company for that building, not from what the caller states. The record that decides it is a program record on the same building; a program record on another of the owner's buildings has no bearing. A program in a blocking status found on the building means the fresh quote is not opened and the existing program's covered units are amended instead.

### Status of the existing program and its effect

| Status of a program already recorded on the building | Effect on a fresh quote for that building |
|---|---|
| Quoted | Blocks; the existing program's covered units are amended instead |
| Active | Blocks; the existing program's covered units are amended instead |
| Pending renewal | Blocks; the existing program's covered units are amended instead |
| Suspended | Blocks; the existing program's covered units are amended instead |
| Expired | Does not block |
| Cancelled | Does not block |
| Declined | Does not block |

### Points of judgement

- An owner with three buildings and one program at each holds three programs; this is within the rule, since the holding is counted per building and no owner-level cap exists.
- A quote that the owner declined stands in declined status, so a later fresh quote for the same building is not blocked by it; a quote that stands open in quoted status does block a second quote for the same building.
- A building whose program is suspended for arrears still holds a program for the purpose of this rule; the way to change what that building is covered for is to amend the covered units of the suspended program, not to open a second program.
- Filter sets credited to a program at one building are not transferred to a program at another building of the same owner, whatever the two buildings' equipment.
